manifest.description: Allocate parsed, cleaned participants independently of CSV cleaning. Preserve input values without normalization. Validate unique nonempty participant IDs and emails, nonempty names, valid first choices and optional valid second choices; validate unique nonempty room and workshop IDs, nonnegative integer capacities, and workshop references to existing rooms. Reject multiple workshops referencing the same room as an unsupported configuration; this operation assumes one concurrent session and initially empty rooms. On validation failure return English errors and empty assignment and waitlist arrays. Each nonempty group_id forms one booking unit including all its members even when noncontiguous; each empty group_id is an individual unit. Process units by the input index of their first member. Try only the first member's first_choice followed by their nonempty second_choice, skipping repeated choices. A candidate is accepted only when every unit member lists it as either preference, its room is open, and remaining seats accommodate the entire unit. Assign the whole unit and decrement that room's remaining seats, or waitlist the whole unit with an English reason. Never split groups, reorder units to fill seats, or consider other workshops. Return assignments and waitlist separately in original participant order. choice_rank is each assigned participant's own preference rank, prioritizing first_choice when both choices match.
manifest.title: Allocate workshop bookings without splitting groups

manifest.description: Parse CSV with required headers id,name,email,first_choice,second_choice,group_id, preserving row order and these fields. Trim surrounding whitespace on every field, collapse internal whitespace in names, and lowercase emails. Preserve case of IDs and preferences. Reject malformed rows, missing IDs, duplicate IDs among previously accepted rows, empty names, invalid emails (require one @ with nonempty local and domain portions and no whitespace), unknown or empty first_choice, and nonempty second_choice not in workshop_ids. Empty second_choice is permitted. Reject duplicate emails only after row validation, retaining the first valid registration per normalized email. Rejected rows do not reserve an ID or email. Treat group_id as an opaque trimmed string, with empty meaning individual. Reject duplicate or missing required headers and unsupported extra headers explicitly rather than silently guessing. Return accepted participants in roster order, a CSV serialized with the six required headers in that order, and rejected row numbers and English reasons. CSV row numbers count the header as row 1. Structural errors return an English errors array with no participants or cleaned CSV.
manifest.title: Clean workshop registration CSV
